_about: Live Bridge insight while typing (contract v1.43, DV-16). The app sends POST /bridge/insight about 1.5 s after typing stops, with an increasing seq; it cancels the request in flight when the text changes and drops any reply whose seq is not the latest. Fictional text.

request.text: You always change plans last minute, so thanks for that.

spans.note: Absolutes tend to land as a verdict on the person, not the moment.

reply_stale._app_does: a reply with seq 6 arriving after seq 7 was sent is dropped, never drawn

reply_risk.line: You matter. If you might hurt yourself or someone else, help is available now.
reply_risk._app_does: stop live insight for this draft, show the safety sheet; the floor runs before any model call

reply_too_short._app_does: under 12 characters: no call, no cost, so no need to debounce these

stored: nothing: the draft is not saved server-side; the call's trace keeps tokens, cents and latency, and the words become length + sha256 prefix
